statement: IVERI gradient explosions are architectural (MoR recursion), NOT LR warmup related. Evidence: Phase-7 warmup sweep (0–200 steps) produces exactly 2 explosions at every warmup value. Evidence: Phase-5/6 No-MoR variant has 1 explosion vs Full 5 explosions across 3 seeds. Root cause: MoR recursive gradient amplification during steps 1–3 before AdamW moment stabilization. Fix: gradient clipping WITHIN MoR recursion depth, not LR schedule change.
